keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Brajan Gruda (RB Leipzig) is shown the yellow card.
András Schäfer (Union Berlin) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match (RB Leipzig). VAR checking.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Zeno Van den Bosch (Union Berlin) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Union Berlin 0, RB Leipzig 1. Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the top left corner.
Goal! Union Berlin 1, RB Leipzig 1. Michel Aebischer (Union Berlin) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
First Half ends, Union Berlin 1, RB Leipzig 1.
Second Half begins Union Berlin 1, RB Leipzig 1.
Goal! Union Berlin 1, RB Leipzig 2. Rômulo (RB Leipzig) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Brajan Gruda following a corner.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Nicolas Seiwald replaces Ezechiel Banzuzi.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Christopher Nkunku replaces Christoph Baumgartner.
Substitution, Union Berlin. Mekhi Gray replaces Andrej Ilic.
Substitution, Union Berlin. Jeong Woo-Yeong replaces Kastriot Imeri.
Delay in match (RB Leipzig).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Rocco Reitz replaces Neil El Aynaoui.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Tidiam Gomis replaces Rômulo.
Goal! Union Berlin 1, RB Leipzig 3. Brajan Gruda (RB Leipzig) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Christopher Nkunku.
Substitution, Union Berlin. Aljoscha Kemlein replaces András Schäfer.
Substitution, Union Berlin. Tim Skarke replaces Oliver Burke.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Andrija Maksimovic replaces Brajan Gruda.
Goal! Union Berlin 1, RB Leipzig 4. Rocco Reitz (RB Leipzig) left footed shot from a difficult angle on the left to the top left corner. Assisted by David Raum with a through ball.
Substitution, Union Berlin. Linus Güther replaces Michel Aebischer.
Goal! Union Berlin 1, RB Leipzig 5. Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Tidiam Gomis with a through ball.
Second Half ends, Union Berlin 1, RB Leipzig 5.
